issues.display_title: Issue #4392: feat(auth): fallback login when Single Sign-On (Keycloak) is down
issues.main_description_html:
Background

With the SSO switch on, the login page and logout send users straight to the Single Sign-On (Keycloak) login page. If the SSO server is down, users end up on a browser error page and have no way to sign in to the dashboard.

The SSO switch is now a runtime feature flag from the API (#4395), and /auth?auth=sso forces SSO regardless of the flag (#4397). The sign-in loading screens come from #4401.

Goal

Before sending users to SSO, the dashboard checks that the SSO server is reachable:

  • SSO reachable: users see "Preparing your sign-in", then go to the SSO login page as they do today.
  • SSO unreachable: users stay on the sign-in page while it re-checks for up to 30 seconds. If SSO is still down, an "Authentication Service Maintenance" dialog lets them sign in with Google or with a sign-in link sent to their email (no password).

Scope

  • "Preparing your sign-in" checks both the sign-in options (feature flag) and SSO health, with real steps: Loading sign-in options → Checking GoThru SSO → Opening secure sign-in. /auth?auth=sso goes through the same check.
  • SSO check: one quick check (1.5s). If it fails, re-check every 10s (up to 3 times) on the same screen, showing the elapsed time. If SSO comes back, users are sent to SSO.
  • After 30s without SSO, the "Authentication Service Maintenance" dialog opens:
    • "Sign in with Google" (uses the existing Google login)
    • Email field + "Send Magic Link", then "Check your inbox" with a resend option after 60s
    • "Retry Now" checks SSO once (button shows loading)
    • The dialog can't be dismissed
  • A page that opens the email link and signs the user in, with a clear message when the link is invalid or expired.
  • Logout goes through the same SSO check, so users aren't stranded on an error page.
  • The "Sign In Failed" screen gets a "Use another sign-in method" button.

Out of Scope

  • Translations beyond English (other languages fall back to English for now).

Acceptance Criteria

  • AC-001: With SSO on and reachable, users see "Preparing your sign-in" (Loading sign-in options → Checking GoThru SSO → Opening secure sign-in), then the SSO login page.
  • AC-002: If SSO doesn't answer within 1.5s, users stay on the same screen while it re-checks every 10s and shows the elapsed time. If it comes back within 30s, they're sent to SSO.
  • AC-003: After 3 failed re-checks (30s), checking stops and the "Authentication Service Maintenance" dialog opens; users can sign in with Google from it.
  • AC-004: Entering a registered email and pressing "Send Magic Link" shows "Check your inbox"; "Resend link" becomes available again after 60 seconds.
  • AC-005: Opening a valid email link signs the user in. An invalid or expired link shows an error with a "Request a new link" button.
  • AC-006: The dialog can't be dismissed and never redirects on its own. "Retry Now" checks SSO once while the button shows loading: if SSO is back, users are sent to SSO; if not, the dialog stays open with "SSO is still unavailable".
  • AC-007: With the SSO switch off, the login page works exactly as it does today.
  • AC-008: Logging out while SSO is down ends on the maintenance dialog.
  • AC-009: Unit tests cover AC-001 – AC-008.

Dependencies

  • GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#2069: magic-link endpoints (POST /v1/auth/magic-link, POST /v1/auth/magic-link/verify), done (PR GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#2071 merged). Needs MAGIC_LINK_ALLOWED_ORIGINS on the API for each dashboard origin.

Related

  • #4388: SSO feature switch
  • #4389: SSO feature switch PR
  • #4395: SSO switch from the feature-flags API
  • #4397: /auth?auth=sso
  • #4401: sign-in loading screens
  • #4393: first attempt, closed as outdated

Result

Screencast.From.2026-10-20.15-46-38.mp4

Shipped in #4405 (merged into development 2026-10-20, c4cae6604). All acceptance criteria AC-001 – AC-009 passed.

  • "Preparing your sign-in" runs real steps (Loading sign-in options → Checking GoThru SSO → Opening secure sign-in) and checks SSO with a no-cors HEAD to Keycloak's .well-known/openid-configuration: first check 1.5s, then re-checks every 10s (2s timeout, max 3) with the elapsed time shown. If SSO comes back, users see "SSO service recovered!" and go to SSO.
  • After 30s the "Authentication Service Maintenance" screen opens. It shipped as a full-screen card in the sign-in screen style (instead of a dialog), with an animated icon, Google sign-in, the magic-link email field (inline errors for 404 / 429 / 503) and "Retry Now" (one check, loading button, "SSO is still unavailable" notice). It can't be dismissed and never redirects on its own.
  • After a link is sent the card switches to "Check your email": the address, link expiry, "Open Email App" (Gmail / Outlook / Yahoo / iCloud inbox, otherwise mailto:), "Resend Link" after the 60s cooldown and "Use a different email".
  • /auth/magic-link verifies the link ("Verifying your sign-in link" with steps → "Welcome back") and signs the user in; an invalid or used link shows an error card with "Request a new link" (opens the maintenance card via /auth?auth=fallback).
  • Logout always goes to /auth, so it goes through the same check. "Sign In Failed" has "Use another sign-in method".
  • Countly: new magic_link login method; SSO staying down is tracked once as login_failed with reason_code: network. The email is never sent.
  • i18n: the new copy uses locale keys (t_sign_in, t_sso_maintenance, t_magic_link, 56 keys) and is translated into all 17 other locales, beyond the original "English only" scope. ba (Bashkir) should still be reviewed by a native speaker.
  • Responsive: auth cards scroll from the top on short screens (phones, landscape) and are more compact below sm.
  • Unit tests: keycloakAuth, useSsoHealthCheck, useMagicLink, Login.countly, SsoMaintenanceCard (incl. "Check your email"), MagicLinkVerify, AuthErrorCard, AuthLoading, Header.countly.

Deploy note: the API needs MAGIC_LINK_ALLOWED_ORIGINS to include each dashboard origin (e.g. https://dev.gothru.co, https://app.gothru.co), otherwise link requests fail with 422.

issues.display_title: Issue #4401: feat(auth): dedicated sign-in loading screens for SSO pre-flight and Keycloak callback
issues.main_description_html:
Background

#4395 made the login page wait for the SSO switch from the API. While it waits, and while users come back from the SSO login page, the dashboard shows the generic loading screen (logo + spinner with "Checking sign-in options", "Connecting to Single Sign-On", "Authenticating with Keycloak"). It doesn't tell users what is happening or that sign-in is progressing.

Goal

Show a dedicated sign-in loading card on the login page and on the SSO return page, with a short checklist of steps, a clear "all set" state, and a "Welcome back" screen with the user's name before entering the dashboard.

Scope

  • New sign-in loading card: GoThru logo, animated icon ring, title, message, and a step checklist (done / in progress / waiting). Soft light background, works in light and dark theme and on phones, respects reduced motion.
  • Login page, while the SSO switch loads ("Preparing your sign-in"):
    • Steps: Checking connection → Preparing secure sign-in → Finalizing setup → Almost there...
    • Steps move forward while waiting and all tick when the check finishes. Later the same screen will also wait for a Keycloak health check (separate task); the screen and copy stay the same.
  • Login page, when the check finishes ("You're all set", shown about 1 second):
    • SSO on: "GoThru SSO is available. Taking you to secure sign-in..." then users go to the SSO login page.
    • SSO off: "Everything is ready. Taking you to sign-in..." (no mention of SSO), then the normal login form shows.
    • /auth?auth=sso still goes to the SSO login page right away without waiting for the switch.
  • SSO return page ("Completing GoThru sign in"):
    • Steps: GoThru account verified → GoThru session created → Profile loaded. Each step ticks when that part of the sign-in actually finishes.
    • Then "Welcome back, " with an animated illustration for about 1.5 seconds, then the dashboard opens. The name comes from the SSO account; if there is no name it shows "Welcome back".

Out of Scope

  • The Keycloak health check itself (later task).
  • The error screens ("Can't load sign-in options", "Sign In Failed") stay as they are.
  • Other loading screens in the dashboard (after reload, payment, unlock) stay as they are.
  • Translations: the new copy is English only, like the current sign-in loading text.

Acceptance Criteria

  • AC-001: While the SSO switch loads, the login page shows "Preparing your sign-in" with the 4 steps moving forward, never the login form.
  • AC-002: SSO on: after the check, "You're all set — GoThru SSO is available..." shows for about 1 second, then users go to the SSO login page.
  • AC-003: SSO off: after the check, "You're all set — Everything is ready..." shows for about 1 second with no mention of SSO, then the login form shows.
  • AC-004: Opening the login page again in the same session (for example, back from Register) with the switch already loaded and off shows the login form directly.
  • AC-005: /auth?auth=sso goes to the SSO login page right away.
  • AC-006: On the SSO return page, "Completing GoThru sign in" shows the 3 steps ticking as sign-in progresses.
  • AC-007: After a successful SSO sign-in, "Welcome back, " with the illustration shows for about 1.5 seconds, then the dashboard opens.
  • AC-008: The screens look right in light and dark theme and on phone width.
  • AC-009: Unit tests cover AC-001 – AC-007.

Related

  • #4395: SSO switch from the API (loading screen this task replaces)
  • #4388: SSO as the login method

Result

Implementation

  • PR: #4402 — merged into development on 2026-10-19 (merge commit dcdb39e)
  • Commits:
    • 5848a37 — feat(auth): dedicated sign-in loading screens for SSO pre-flight and Keycloak callback
    • bc1002b — fix(auth): use GoThru instead of Photo Studio in sign-in loading copy
    • f3caa66 — feat(auth): use auth-bg-pattern image for the sign-in loading background
  • Behavior:
    • New sign-in loading card (AuthLoading): GoThru logo, animated icon ring or welcome illustration, title, message and a step checklist, on the auth-bg-pattern background. Works in light and dark theme and on phones, respects reduced motion.
    • Login page: "Preparing your sign-in" while the SSO switch loads, then "You're all set" for about 1.2 seconds. SSO on: "GoThru SSO is available..." then the SSO login page. SSO off: "Everything is ready..." (no SSO mention) then the login form. With the switch already loaded on arrival, the page continues straight away. /auth?auth=sso still goes to SSO right away.
    • SSO return page: "Completing GoThru sign in" with GoThru account verified → GoThru session created → Profile loaded, each ticking on the real progress, then "Welcome back, " with the illustration for about 1.5 seconds, then the dashboard. The name comes from the SSO account ("Welcome back" when there is none).
    • Names with accents or non-Latin letters now display correctly.

Testing

  • CI=true npx craco test --watchAll=false src/pages/Auth src/components/molecules/AuthLoading src/hooks/useTimedSteps src/utils/keycloakAuth src/App.test → 8 suites passed (AC-009)
    • Pre-flight steps moving while the switch loads, no login form (AC-001)
    • "You're all set" with the SSO copy and redirect only after the delay (AC-002); without SSO copy, then the login form (AC-003)
    • Login form right away when the switch was already loaded (AC-004); ?auth=sso immediate (AC-005)
    • Callback steps ticking with real progress (AC-006); welcome with the name, login only after the delay, name fallbacks (AC-007)
  • Full suite: the 8 suites (27 tests) that fail also fail on development without this change.
  • Manual test by @alfarez21: AC-001 – AC-008 passed.

issues.display_title: Issue #4398: feat(ai-copilot): support global tour action modals with post-action status feedback
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Currently, when Ask AI / RAG Copilot triggers tour tool actions (archive_tour, transfer_tour, download_tour, add_tour_tags, add_tags, delete_tour), Layout.jsx forces a redirect to /my-tours with router state rag_action. This disrupts user context on non-tour pages (e.g. /profile, /storage, /billing), and couples modal handling to page-specific lifecycles (List.jsx and TourTools.jsx).

This issue introduces a dedicated GlobalTourActionModal mounted globally in Layout.jsx to render tour tool actions from anywhere, complete with post-action status feedback via AfterBatchActionPopup and background event synchronization.

Proposed Changes

  1. New Component GlobalTourActionModal:
    • Location: src/components/organism/TourTools/GlobalTourActionModal.jsx
    • Normalizes single and batch tour parameters (tour_id, tours, tour, business_name, cid, goverlay_active, is_active).
    • Delegates to existing tour modals (ArchiveTour, ArchiveTourActiveVT, TransferTour, DownloadTour, AddTags, DeleteTour).
    • Guards download_tour with dunning payment check if isPastDue.
    • On successful action:
      • Parses status using getBusinessNames(response).
      • Displays AfterBatchActionPopup with operation status and message table.
      • Dispatches window event gothru:tour_updated to trigger background refreshes across open pages.
      • Navigates to /my-tours only if deleting/transferring the active tour on /my-tours/:id.
  2. src/components/layouts/Layout.jsx:
    • Mounts GlobalTourActionModal.
    • Replaces forced navigation with direct modal opening upon receiving gothru:action for TOUR_TOOL_TARGETS.
    • Maintains Countly telemetry parity (rag_client_action_executed with action: 'open_modal').
  3. Background Sync & Cleanup:
    • src/pages/Tour/List/List.jsx: Removes redundant gothru:action listener and subscribes to gothru:tour_updated to refresh tour list.
    • src/components/organism/TourDetail/TourTools.jsx: Removes duplicate local listener and subscribes to gothru:tour_updated.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Ask AI tour action triggers (archive_tour, transfer_tour, download_tour, add_tour_tags, delete_tour) open immediately from any page without URL redirect.
  • Active Virtual Tours prompt ArchiveTourActiveVT instead of standard ArchiveTour.
  • On action completion, AfterBatchActionPopup opens displaying success/failure summary.
  • gothru:tour_updated event is emitted and refreshes /my-tours or tour details in the background.
  • Deleting the active tour while viewing /my-tours/:id redirects back to /my-tours once the success popup is closed.
  • Unit tests pass for GlobalTourActionModal, Layout.countly.test.jsx, and List.rag.test.jsx.
  • Linter passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings.

Demo by Developer

issues.display_title: Issue #4394: feat(chat-ai): slash command (/command) autocomplete and atomic styled pill input
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Implement slash command autocomplete (/command) and atomic pill styling in the Ask AI input, enabling users to trigger modal workflows (e.g. /archive, /delete, /transfer) and feature navigation via a unified /navigate command with subtarget suggestions.

Epic Reference

  • Epic: #4377 ([PRD] GoThru Dashboard Ask AI Sidebar Chat)

Scope of Work

  • Command Catalog:
    • Define standard root slash commands (/archive, /transfer, /download, /tag, /delete, /create-tour).
    • Define unified /navigate command with subtargets (upload, edit, publish, virtual-tour, storage, my-tours).
  • Input Refactor (contenteditable):
    • Migrate ChatInput from <textarea> to <div contenteditable="true"> to support inline atomic pill styling.
    • Render selected slash commands as atomic <span class="slash-command-pill" contenteditable="false">/command</span> elements.
    • Implement atomic deletion: pressing Backspace immediately after a pill removes the entire command token in one stroke.
    • Enforce plain-text paste sanitization on onPaste.
  • Autocomplete Dropdown:
    • Detect / typed at start of input or after whitespace (excluding URLs/mid-word slashes).
    • Provide full keyboard navigation (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Tab, Escape).
    • Support 2-level autocomplete for /navigate to seamlessly transition to subtarget options.
  • Backend & Coexistence:
    • Serialize editor DOM content to clean plain-text string on submission.
    • Seamlessly coexist with @tour mention flow (TourMentionDropdown and tour chips).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Typing / triggers SlashCommandDropdown with keyboard navigation (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Tab, Escape).
  • Selecting /navigate transitions dropdown to subtarget suggestions (upload, edit, publish, virtual-tour, storage, my-tours).
  • Selected commands render as non-editable styled pill spans inside the contenteditable container.
  • Pressing Backspace after a pill deletes the entire pill token in a single action.
  • Submitting via Enter (without Shift) extracts clean plaintext (e.g. "/archive" or "/navigate storage") and sends payload to /copilot/chat.
  • Pasting formatted rich text into the editor inserts plain text only.
  • Coexists smoothly with @tour mention chips without state conflicts.
  • Unit tests pass for slashCommands, useSlashCommand, SlashCommandDropdown, and updated ChatInput.

Demo by Developer
